source_text: Post has ostensiones in carcere etiam diebus paucis commorati, producuntur in publicum, ut eos Cirtensium magistratus elogio fortissimae confessionis honoratos transmitterent cum parte iam damnationis ad praesidem. Et ecce unus e circumstantibus fratribus nostris omnium in se gentilium conuertit oculos, quod iam per gratiam proximae passionis Christus in eius ore et facie relucebat. Cumque ex eo turbulentis et furentibus animis quaereretur an eiusdem et ipse esset religionis et nominis, rapuit tam dulcem promptissima confessione comitatum. Elogiis suis beati martyres plures dei testes, dum ipsi ad martyrium parantur, adquirunt; et iam transmissi ad praesidem, negotiosum ac difficile iter cum uoluntate properabant. Tunc eos praesidi admotos iterum Lambesitanus carcer accepit. Haec enim sola apud gentiles hospitia iustorum.
thought_title: Sent to the governor with one more companion gained
orientation: The narrator goes on after the prison visions as the prisoners are moved in public from Cirta toward the governor.
pass_a_gloss: After these visions, having remained in prison also for a few days, they are led out into public, that the magistrates of the people of Cirta, having honored them with the official report of bravest confession of faith, might send them on to the governor with a portion of condemnation already. And behold one from the brothers standing around us turned upon himself the eyes of all the pagans, because now through the grace of the suffering close at hand Christ was shining back in his mouth and face. And when it was being asked of him with disturbed and raging minds whether he himself was also of the same religion and name, he seized companionship so sweet with most ready confession of faith. By their official reports the blessed martyrs gain more witnesses of God, while they themselves are being prepared for martyrdom; and now sent on to the governor, they were hastening through a troublesome and difficult journey with willingness. Then when brought to the governor, the prison at Lambaesis received them again. For these are the only lodgings of just people among pagans.

choices.english: official report / By their official reports

choices.why: fixed glossary for confessio as public avowal
fixed glossary for martyres as those dying for confessing Christ
rejected: witnesses who die for their faith

pass_b_english: After these visions they lingered a few days longer in prison, and then they were brought out in public. The magistrates of Cirta honored them with the official report of their bravest confession of faith, to send them on to the governor with part of their condemnation already decided. One of our brothers standing nearby drew the eyes of all the pagans upon himself, for through the grace of the suffering now close at hand Christ already shone in his face and speech. When they demanded of him in agitated fury whether he too belonged to the same faith and Name, he seized so sweet a companionship with an immediate confession of faith.

By their official reports the blessed martyrs gain many more witnesses to God while they themselves are being made ready for martyrdom. Once handed over to the governor, they hastened willingly along the hard and busy road. When they were presented to the governor, the prison at Lambaesis received them. For among the pagans this alone lodges the righteous.
